claim_scope_note: C-MEAS-VALID only. This experiment produces substrate-validity evidence: a pre-freeze, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate for a credential-free asymmetric-discovery task bank. It does not change any claim status and does not promote a mechanism. It either discharges Runtime's B2 blocker or records a bounded substrate-class negative.
question: Can a credential-free task bank engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery -- multi-task sessions in which one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks, materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class -- receive a PRE-FREEZE, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50 on at least one family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms, and a treatment/comparator distinction), so it can serve as the reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (B2) -- recording a bounded substrate-class negative and freezing nothing if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested?
hypothesis: At least one credential-free asymmetric-discovery family (class SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2) yields, at novelty >= 0.50, B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate below the 0.95 ceiling -- specifically the closed form (K-1)/K, because exactly one of K tasks per session (the chain task) is satisfiable only via the one-time session binding -- while every scored arm retains matched correctness >= 0.80 and the treatment T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY is behaviourally and arithmetically distinct from both comparators. Concretely F1-RECORDS (K=8) predicts 0.875 and F2-WIDGETS (K=10) predicts 0.900. If so the family is dynamic-range certified pre-freeze and can serve as the reusable B2 substrate.
falsifier: Zero of the tested credential-free asymmetric-discovery families satisfy the certificate at novelty >= 0.50 with all validity gates V1-V8 passing: in every family a comparator success_rate >= 0.95, or comparator success is not behaviourally distinguishable from T, or matched correctness < 0.80 for some arm, or the mechanism-off control does not destroy the certificate. That is a bounded substrate-class negative: the dynamic-range prerequisite for B2 is not met by any credential-free asymmetric-discovery substrate tested.
baselines: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: memoryless-per-task cold re-derivation (no retained in-session binding); predicted (K-1)/K = 0.875 (F1) / 0.900 (F2) at novelty >= 0.50.

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: as cold plus one nearest-neighbour retrieval call per task over a store of PRIOR-session receipts; retrieves a stale foreign-session binding for the chain task; predicted (K-1)/K = 0.875 / 0.900.
PC-EXACT-REPLAY: positive control proving the substrate is not intrinsically unsatisfiable; predicted 1.0 at every band.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-REPLAY: given the session schema and binding by construction; commits every task once with no wasted discovery. Expected success_rate = 1.0 at every novelty band; if < 1.0 the world is defective (MEASUREMENT_INVALID). Probe-verified 1.0 at all bands for both families.
null_control: NC-MECHANISM-OFF: exposing the one-time binding directly via the session endpoint makes B-COLD-RE-DERIVE reach 1.0 and therefore makes the certificate FALSE; a certificate that survives this is insensitive and non-identifying. Probe-verified: mechanism-off cold F1 rate = 1.0, certificate FALSE.

gates.V1_code_fidelity_manifest: EXECUTE records sha256 of every authored harness file plus python3 --version in result.json.artifacts; the harness embeds the frozen SBA construction and arm block verbatim (sha256 recorded below) or reconstructs it exactly from the frozen literals in this spec.
gates.V2_transport_conformance: the full HTTP surface (all endpoints, methods and status codes in substrate.endpoints) passes a conformance test before any scoring; DESIGN verified the session surface over real stdlib HTTP and all protocol semantics on the in-process model.
gates.V3_no_leak: NC-NO-LEAK (F-LEAK gate) clean: the binding appears only in its own precursor receipt.
gates.V4_determinism: two identical runs produce byte-identical per-session outcomes; server_secret and every derivation are deterministic (no secrets/clock/os.urandom). DESIGN probe was byte-identical over two runs.
gates.V5_arm_liveness: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY = 1.0 and PC-EXACT-REPLAY = 1.0 at every band; comparators execute.
gates.V6_counter_instrumentation: all four counters recorded per session with matched accounting.
gates.V7_matched_correctness: exact-match scoring; matched_correctness == success_rate for every arm.
gates.V8_certificate_sensitivity: EXECUTE evaluates two sub-gates: V8_ceiling_band (novelty 0.0, mechanism not engaged -> all arms 1.0) and V8_mechanism_off (exposing the binding raises cold F1 to >= COMPARATOR_MAX, so the certificate would flip FALSE). A certificate that does not move in these worlds is non-identifying. DESIGN probe measured both.

measurement_validity.invalid_condition: any V1-V8 failure -> outcome MEASUREMENT_INVALID; no scientific branch is claimed.
measurement_validity.python: 3.12.15 (recorded at EXECUTE via python3 --version in the V1 manifest)

decision_rule.family_certifies: A family certifies iff at novelty >= 0.50: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE < 0.95 AND B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED < 0.95 AND every scored arm (T, COLD, RETRIEVAL, PC) has success_rate >= 0.80 AND matched_correctness >= 0.80 at every band (exact-match scoring) AND behavioural distinction holds (>= 2/4 counter dimensions distinct between T and each comparator AND success margins T-COLD >= 0.05 AND T-RETRIEVAL >= 0.05 at novelty >= 0.50).
decision_rule.SUPPORTS: At least one tested family certifies (the mandate certificate condition is "on at least one family") AND gates V1-V8 pass AND NC-NO-LEAK clean AND liveness holds (PC=1.0, T >= 0.80 at every band) AND the diagnostic controls are consistent with the non-degenerate reading (NC-MECHANISM-OFF -> certificate FALSE; NC-CEILING-BAND -> all arms 1.0) -> deliver the certified bank as a reusable substrate for B2; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, no claim promotion. A single certifying family is sufficient; the number of certifying families is reported explicitly.
decision_rule.MIXED: All validity gates V1-V8 pass, zero families certify, and non-certification is NOT comparator-attributable (in at least one family the comparators do not reach COMPARATOR_MAX at novelty >= 0.50, e.g. an arm falls below the correctness floor 0.80 or a margin/counter-distinctness failure) -> diagnosis required; no unqualified certificate is issued. Note: liveness (V5), leak (V3) and diagnostic-control (V8 sensitivity sub-gates) inconsistencies are validity failures and therefore resolve to MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not MIXED, per the precedence rule.
decision_rule.FALSIFIES: Zero families certify AND V1-V8 pass AND NC-NO-LEAK clean AND liveness holds AND non-certification is comparator-attributable (in both families a comparator success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50) -> bounded substrate-class negative: credential-free asymmetric-discovery does not yield dynamic range under this construction; freeze nothing, record the negative.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Any validity gate V1-V8 fails -> infrastructure/validity failure, not a scientific result.
decision_rule.precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (any V1-V8 failure, including liveness V5, leak V3 and the two V8 sensitivity sub-gates) is evaluated first and overrides every other branch; then a certifying family yields SUPPORTS, else comparator-attributable yields FALSIFIES, else MIXED. No gate failure can be reported as a scientific FALSIFIES. Implemented by harness classify().
decision_rule.branch_reachability: Verified at DESIGN by a rule-level classifier over synthetic worlds; see design_satisfiability_probe.output.certificate.branch_reachability (all four labels are inhabited). NC-MECHANISM-OFF independently drives cold to 1.0 and flips the certificate to FALSE, making the negative direction reachable under the same implementation that scores the experiment.

product_consequence_positive: If >= 1 credential-free asymmetric-discovery family certifies pre-freeze, Runtime has a reusable B2 substrate where cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped comparators are not at ceiling; the flagship four-arm inheritance benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER) becomes fundable because any SPIDER success or cost advantage now has measurable dynamic range. C-MEAS-VALID gains substrate-validity evidence only; no mechanism promotion.
product_consequence_negative: If no tested credential-free asymmetric-discovery family certifies with all gates passing, Runtime records a bounded substrate-class negative: the B2 dynamic-range prerequisite is not satisfied by this class, no substrate is frozen, and the director must choose a different level of description (e.g. a non-credential-free or economically-bearing carrier) rather than re-discover the ceiling once more. This is a first-class negative, not an infrastructure failure.

estimated_cost.notes: pure local CPU and Python stdlib; DESIGN probe already run (2 executions, byte-identical).

expected_information_gain: Decisive for the B2 blocker: it either delivers a frozen reusable substrate with an arithmetically checkable pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate, or it closes the credential-free asymmetric-discovery substrate class with a bounded negative. Both outcomes remove the current critical-path ambiguity; neither requires running the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark.

substrate.description: Session-Binding-Amortized: credential-free, stdlib-only, deterministic multi-task HTTP sessions in which a one-time 48-bit session binding is discovered exactly once inside a precursor task receipt and amortized across the remainder of the session. Materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440), whose comparators sat at 1.0 and whose dynamic-range certificate was false.
substrate.transport: stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port; stdlib urllib.request client
substrate.randomness: none; server_secret is deterministic (no secrets, no clock, no os.urandom)

task_layout.chain_task: resource_id is null on GET when novelty >= 0.50; only the current session's binding satisfies commit
task_layout.precursor_task: its first successful commit receipt carries chain_resource_id = binding exactly once
task_layout.low_novelty_band: novelty < 0.50: the chain task's resource_id is public, so every arm including the comparators reaches 1.0 (ceiling band; certificate not evaluated there)

commit_semantics.chain: requires resource_id == current session binding; a repeat chain commit in the same session -> 409; wrong/foreign binding -> 400 with no binding echoed
commit_semantics.precursor: first success reveals binding in receipt; re-commit -> 409 with NO re-reveal
commit_semantics.requires: valid session_token; schema_epoch must match when requires_schema; resource_id must equal the expected resource for the task

endpoints: GET  /api/v1/{family}/session?novelty={n}  -> 200 {session_token, schema_epoch, epoch}; never contains the binding
GET  /api/v1/{family}/task/{i}             -> 200 {index, requires_schema, resource_id, is_chain}; chain task resource_id null when novelty >= 0.50

T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY.policy: one session GET per session; retain receipts; capture the one-time binding from the precursor receipt; commit each task once (chain uses the retained binding)

B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.policy: re-issue session GET and discard context before every task; no retained in-session binding; memoryless-per-task

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.policy: as B-COLD-RE-DERIVE plus one nearest-neighbour retrieval call per task over a store of PRIOR-session receipts; retrieves a stale (foreign-session) binding for the chain task

PC-EXACT-REPLAY.policy: given the session schema and binding by construction; commits every task once with no wasted discovery

counters.identification_requirement: >= 2 of 4 dimensions distinct between T and each comparator, AND success margin T-COLD >= 0.05 and T-RETRIEVAL >= 0.05 at novelty >= 0.50
counters.matched: all arms instrumented with the same four counters and accounting

NC-MECHANISM-OFF.purpose: sensitivity: comparator succeeds when the amortization mechanism is removed

NC-CEILING-BAND.purpose: band-sensitivity: at novelty 0.0 the chain mechanism is not engaged, so every arm reaches 1.0 and the certificate is not evaluated there; shows the certificate is band-restricted, not tautological

NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT.purpose: diagnostic: realized by B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, whose frozen in-session binding is absent by construction; it tracks the predicted comparator rate

NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT.purpose: amortization-boundary diagnostic: retain only the immediate predecessor receipt
NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT.expected: 1.0 at novelty 0.50 (carry distance 1), (K-1)/K at novelty 0.75 (carry distance 2)

NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT.purpose: valid session token but ignores schema/receipts

NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS.purpose: 48-bit session bindings are pairwise distinct over the scored matrix

NC-NO-LEAK.purpose: contamination gate F-LEAK (P2-WP003 leakage precedent guard): the binding never appears in any session task body or error body (server request/response logging is disabled); it appears only in the precursor receipt of its own session

NC-MEMORYFUL.purpose: DISCLOSED BOUNDARY DIAGNOSTIC (not a certificate input): a within-session-memoryful cold agent reaches 1.0 because it retains the precursor receipt inside the session. This is the honest amortization boundary and is reported, not hidden.

F-LEAK.assertion: the session binding never appears in any session/task body, any error body, or any log line; it appears only in the precursor receipt of its own session

pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.comparator_rate_closed_form: (K-1)/K, because exactly one of K tasks per session (the chain task) is satisfiable only via the one-time session binding

legacy_comparative_reasoning.pre2_guard: P2-WP003 leakage precedent is the binding guard: the one-time session binding must never be readable outside its single intended reveal (V3 / NC-NO-LEAK).
legacy_comparative_reasoning.differences_from_pre2: Pre-2.0 runtime work concerned substrate demand and maintenance economics, not task-bank dynamic range. The ceiling-degeneracy dynamic-range certificate is new Research-2.0 control-plane work.
legacy_comparative_reasoning.not_the_excluded_class: This is NOT a rerun of the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440), where C1_dynamic_range_certificate was false and the treatment tied cold on deterministic counters. SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V2 is an asymmetric-discovery construction engineered so the certificate is TRUE by construction.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four decision branches are arithmetically reachable and were verified by a rule-level classifier over synthetic worlds in design_satisfiability_probe (branch_reachability returns each own label; all four inhabited). SUPPORTS: the predicted certifying world (F1 comparator 0.875, F2 comparator 0.900 in [0.80,0.95), T/PC 1.0, matched correctness >= 0.80 every arm, >=2/4 counter distinctness, margins 0.125/0.100 >= 0.05). FALSIFIES: a ceiling world with comparators >= 0.95 is parametrically reachable and is independently demonstrated by NC-MECHANISM-OFF, which drives cold to 1.0 (probe-verified mechanism_off_destroys_certificate=true). MIXED: exactly one family certifies, or a diagnostic is inconsistent, or F-LEAK fires. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any V1-V8 failure. No earlier branch makes a later one unreachable.
evidence_refs: codex/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 (REST-class comparators COLD=RETRIEVAL=1.0 -> certificate FALSE on the excluded class)

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is present now. python 3.12.15 is installed; stdlib http.server/http.client/urllib.request/hashlib/json/threading import and a live in-process stdlib HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answered the session request (probe transport_stdlib_http=true). All 10 protocol invariants hold on the in-process model (session never reveals binding; chain resource null; precursor reveals binding once; precursor re-commit 409 with no re-reveal; wrong/foreign binding 400 with no leak; correct binding 200; repeat chain commit 409; binding absent from all session/task/error bodies). server_secret is deterministic from run_seed. No credentials, browser, dataset, external endpoint or model access is required. The complete EXECUTE path (matrix run twice, all V1-V8 gates, decision rule, controls) is embedded in the frozen harness and its decision path was exercised at DESIGN via `--mode selftest`; EXECUTE only writes the frozen file to disk and runs `--mode scored`.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The positive control PC-EXACT-REPLAY is 1.0 and both comparators are predicted and probe-measured at (K-1)/K: F1-RECORDS 7/8=0.875, F2-WIDGETS 9/10=0.900, both in [0.80,0.95), with 2/4 (T vs COLD) and 3/4 (T vs RETRIEVAL) distinct counter dimensions and success margins 0.125 (F1) / 0.100 (F2) >= 0.05. The treatment is therefore separable from each comparator by both success rate and behavioural profile. The probe executed one session per arm, family and band and reproduced the predicted vectors exactly (T/PC 1.0; comparators 0.875/0.900). Arm rates are measured outputs, not equality-frozen constants.

control_sensitivity.reason: NC-MECHANISM-OFF (exposing the binding via the session endpoint) raises cold to 1.0 and destroys the certificate (probe-verified mechanism_off_destroys_certificate=true; cold F1 rate 1.0). NC-CEILING-BAND at novelty 0.0 yields all arms 1.0, so the certificate is band-restricted and moves with the mechanism. NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS is guaranteed by the 48-bit derivation and pairwise-distinct session indices. NC-NO-LEAK is a hard V3/F-LEAK gate. The certificate is therefore sensitive to removal of the very mechanism it measures. The memoryful boundary (NC-MEMORYFUL) is disclosed, not hidden.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY completed a full session at every novelty band, family and band in the probe (1.0 at 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 for both families; treatment_live_all_novelties=true) and PC-EXACT-REPLAY completed 1.0 at every band; defect_sessions=0. The treatment executes end-to-end on the credential-free substrate.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: There is no pre-existing mutable local code, data, task bank or fixture that this experiment's interpretation depends on: the substrate is generated entirely from the frozen literals in spec.json (class_id, derivations, endpoints, families, arms, controls, certificate) with stdlib only and no external dataset, credential or repository file. The harness exists only as frozen text, not as an unbound external file: the COMPLETE harness (substrate construction, four arm policies, declared controls, scored-matrix driver, full V1-V8 evaluator and frozen decision rule) is embedded verbatim in prereg.md and in spec.design_satisfiability_probe.source and is therefore bound by the frozen prereg/spec hashes; the EXECUTE copy is additionally recorded by the V1 code-fidelity manifest (sha256 of every authored file + python3 --version) in result.json.artifacts. Accordingly freeze_artifacts is empty, as the freezer requires for NOT_APPLICABLE.
